APPROVE

The method is still an iterator, so the corpus scan stays lazy, and the extracted helpers keep the original filter conditions in the same short-circuit order, so behaviour is unchanged. The main method's cognitive complexity drops to roughly 5. I couldn't build or inspect the repo here, so I haven't confirmed that `IsScalaType` has no overloads and that `BypassedCtorFqns` and `IsBypassCandidate` don't already exist in the class.
